The secession event (entity_17) triggers a legal process that requires approval from the State Legislature (entity_28 → entity_17). Hence, the board’s announcement implies that the State Legislature will have to act on the proposal.

Kayla Brown publicly supports the creation of the State of Jefferson (entity_7 → entity_4). The concept of the State of Jefferson is directly linked to neighboring Humboldt County (entity_11 → entity_4). Therefore, her support ties the interests of residents in Siskiyou County to the potential involvement of Humboldt County in the new state.
